multi_entity_note: Single patient with S. gallolyticus epidural abscess leading to sigmoid adenocarcinoma.

medical.diagnosis.rationale: Investigation ultimately led to the diagnosis of sigmoid adenocarcinoma, after sciatica had been suspected and an epidural abscess found.

medical.treatment_drug.rationale: Adenocarcinoma was treated by resection and unspecified chemotherapy; ceftriaxone treated the epidural abscess.
